<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var modal = document.createElement("div");
  modal.className = "talk-modal";
  modal.hidden = true;
  modal.innerHTML = '<div class="talk-modal-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">' +
    '<button class="talk-modal-close" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>' +
    '<div class="talk-modal-body"></div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(modal);
  var body = modal.querySelector(".talk-modal-body");
  function close() { modal.hidden = true; }
  modal.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === modal) close(); });
  modal.querySelector(".talk-modal-close").addEventListener("click", close);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape") close(); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".schedule-event.talk").forEach(function (card) {
    var abstract = card.querySelector(".talk-abstract");
    if (!abstract) return;
    card.addEventListener("click", function () {
      body.innerHTML = card.querySelector("p").outerHTML + abstract.innerHTML;
      modal.hidden = false;
    });
  });
});
</script>
